'''Slumbering Beetle''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in {{2|Hive}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Slumbering Beetle}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Snore
|Intent = Sleep
|Effect = Does nothing. Asleep.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Roll Out
|Intent = Attack3, Buff
|Effect = Deals (16;{{Asc2|9|18}}) damage. Gains 2 {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
The Slumbering Beetle starts asleep and uses {{Int2|Slumbering Beetle|Snore}} each turn while it has {{BD2|Slumber}}. Once {{BD2|Slumber}} wears off (after taking turns or losing HP 3 times), it wakes up, loses its {{BD2|Plating}}, and uses {{Int2|Slumbering Beetle|Roll Out}} every turn.

== Trivia ==
* The {{M2|Frog Knight}} rides on a smaller version of the '''Slumbering Beetle'''.
* The '''Slumbering Beetle''' makes a quiet ambient snoring sound while sleeping.
